plan.about: The audit plan the F1 Finance Audit Machine follows for the invented HANGS Construction Development LP. The runner reads its rates, seed, sample sizes and threshold from here; the Confirmations system shows it. Every name and figure is invented.

materiality.why: Book income is what the partners and a lender watch for a profit-making homebuilder. The engagement partner sets the final amounts.

sample.method: Each population is numbered by reference. Picks are drawn without repeats by a fixed pseudo-random generator started from the seed, so anyone can draw the same sample again.
sample.keyItems: Every other entry to an expense account at or above performance materiality is tested in full.

journalTraits.name: Entered After Year End
journalTraits.rule: Dated by June 30 but entered after it

journalTraits.name: Entered on a Weekend or Holiday
journalTraits.rule: Entered on a Saturday, Sunday or holiday

journalTraits.name: Round Hand-Entered Amount
journalTraits.rule: Typed by hand, $1,000 or more, in whole hundreds

journalTraits.name: Entered by Someone Who Rarely Posts
journalTraits.rule: Entered by someone who posts under 1% of journals

journalTraits.name: Touches the Partner Accounts
journalTraits.rule: Debits or credits the partner capital or distribution accounts

journalTraits.name: Estimate or Accrual Words
journalTraits.rule: Description says accrual, provision, reserve, estimate, adjustment and the like

procedures.what: Recompute the trial balance from every ledger line, agree it to the statements and propose materiality.
Draw the seeded sample, agree each pick to its invoice, test the key items, trace every vendor invoice on file and match every closing to the escrow report.
Check every July payment against the June 30 payables, the sales cutoff, last year's payable and the expense lines for fixed assets.
Scan all journals for six risk traits, follow each one up, roll the reserves forward and agree the distributions.
Tie cash to the bank's own letter and statements, and compare the year with last year and month by month.
Add up what was found against materiality and write the workpapers and the findings memo. The CPA concludes.
